messages.en:
{07 14 00}I just put that fossil up in
my place, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
It's totally adorable!
{07 0d 00}It didn't exactly match the
theme of my room...{01 00 00 0a 00}but it
still looked pretty good!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Panin selle fossiili just
enda juures üles, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
See on täiesti armas!
{07 0d 00}See ei sobinud just
mu toa teemaga...{01 00 00 0a 00}aga
nägi ikka päris hea välja!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Do you think it's at all
weird to be a fossil
collector, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 11 00}But, hey...{01 00 00 05 00} If I do the
unexpected, then I, like,
keep people guessing!{01 00 00 0a 00} YES!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Kas sinu meelest on veider
olla fossiilikoguja,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 11 00}Aga kuule...{01 00 00 05 00} Kui ma teen
ootamatut, siis ma, nagu,
hoian inimesi ärevil!{01 00 00 0a 00} JAH!
